title: Acquirer: Inghams Enterprises Pty Ltd; Target: Chickadee Foods Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Inghams Enterprises P/L seeks to acquire the remaining shares in Chickadee Foods P/L. Inghams has owned a 26% share in the company since 1988
body_sections.Market definition: The market was considered to be the national market for processed chicken meat products
body_sections.Competition analysis: On the basis of the information supplied by the parties and market inquiries the proposed acquisition does not appear to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant market for the following reasons (1) Other market participants are able to compete effectively for supply contracts (2) Customers exercise a signficant degree of market power (3) Vertical integration is not necessary to compete effectively in the market
